items.title: Pay dog-training invoice
items.quote: Zahlbar 14 Tage nach Rechnungsdatum per Überweisung.
items.computation: Start: invoice date 21.11.2026 (Saturday). Counting the day of the event is not included (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB); 14 days after 21.11.2026 lands on 05.12.2026, which is also a Saturday. Under § 193 BGB, when the last day of a period for a declaration or payment falls on a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, the period ends on the next business day. The next business day after Saturday 05.12.2026 is Monday 07.12.2026 (no NW public holiday in between). So the payment must arrive by 07.12.2026; to allow for the up-to-one-business-day bank transfer float (§ 675s BGB), the transfer should be sent by 04.12.2026.

warnings: The letter's own data (sender address "Mustergießen", customer "Bastian Musterquell" in "Beispielwetzlar", and BIC "MUSTDEMMXXX") are standard German placeholder/sample values, so this looks like a template or demo invoice rather than a genuine bill — verify with the actual school before paying.

The IBAN DE10 3705 0198 0005 5491 20 is formally valid (checksum and bank-code format correct), but a valid IBAN does not prove who owns the account; confirm the payee name matches Hundeschule Beispielpfote via your bank's mandatory recipient-name check before transferring.
